(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing does not state whether this tolerance is before or after the I.Z.B.P. plating; plating buildup could push the hole out of its H7 limits and prevent assembly with the mating shaft. The designer should add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating, or provide an undersize pre-plate dimension to allow for coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'H7 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or specify the pre-plate machining size accounting for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
